color.$description: shadcn/ui's colour roles, light mode (the default). Dark values: color.dark.json. The values are shadcn/ui's stock `neutral` theme (D-43), with every neutral step made warm (D-50: color.warm). To change a colour: point the role at another primitive of tokens/primitive/color.json (add the value there first), here and in color.dark.json, then npm run tokens:build.

canvas.$description: The app's backdrop behind the floating sidebar and the cards (D-50): a step darker than `card` in light, so a card stands on it. Text never sits on it directly but in a card or the shell's bars.

backdrop-from.$description: Start of the onboarding backdrop (D-52): a light gradient from the top start corner (from → via → to). Used only by the `surface-backdrop` class in src/index.css. Text never sits on it directly but in the page's own surfaces and the frosted bars.

backdrop-via.$description: Middle of the onboarding backdrop gradient (D-52).

backdrop-to.$description: End of the onboarding backdrop gradient (D-52), at the bottom end corner.

surface-frosted.$description: Background of a surface of ours that floats or sticks over scrolling content (D-47): translucent, drawn with the backdrop blur surface.frosted.blur. Its text is the role the surface already carries (foreground, popover-foreground). Used only by the `surface-frosted` class in src/index.css.

surface-frosted-shadow.$description: Colour of the small shadow around a frosted surface (D-47).

forced.$description: Outline colour of the focus indicator under forced-colors. One value, no mode.
